Initial release of dlazy-keling-tts.

- Introduces a CLI tool for converting text into high-quality, emotional speech using Kling TTS.
- Supports multiple options: language selection, voice ID, speed, audio format, and input methods.
- Provides detailed error codes and agent handling instructions for API key and credit issues.
- Includes sample commands and output formats for easy reference.
- Installation guide via npm and further help via dlazy keling-tts -h.
